data.description: Captured 2026-09-04 during the session-notification brainstorm (epic allstar-holy-hairstreak). DEFERRED: classification beyond notification scope; v1 ingestion files untriaged ops-alert bugs and the first claimer triages with the bug close_class vocabulary. Prior art: OpenStack elastic-recheck per-bug query fingerprints (>10% match on passing jobs = too broad), Mozilla Treeherder intermittent signatures, Chromium Sheriff-o-Matic snooze-until-revision. Critique's mandatory mitigations if built: every signature carries an expiry date; every suppression is counted and surfaced (an uncategorized + suppressed bucket); a signature whose hit-rate jumps 10x is auto-un-suppressed. Without those three the registry is a regression-hiding machine.
data.title: Known-signature (NOT-A-BUG) registry for alert ingestion, elastic-recheck style
